dialog-enter.$description: A dialog grows from this scale as it opens. GB st-dialog-in.

window-enter.$description: A window grows from this scale as it opens and shrinks to it as it closes. GB window motion.ts and window-layer.css.

press.$description: Press feedback on native controls. Closest source: GB st-menu-in starts at 0.97.

menu-enter.$description: A menu or list popup grows from this scale as it opens. GB st-menu-in.

pop.$description: Peak scale of a mark, badge or chip that lands with an overshoot (keyframe form of the bouncy spring). Order 1.22, proposed.

stretch.$description: How far a thumb or indicator stretches along its travel while it moves or is held. Order 1.22, proposed.

lift.$description: Scale of a card or tile that lifts under the pointer. Order 1.22, proposed.

anticipate.$description: Scale of the wind up before an action plays: a press that gathers before it releases. Order 1.22, proposed.

enter.$description: Start scale of content that enters inside an overlay or a list. Order 1.22, proposed.

morph.$description: Scale a part shrinks to as it leaves an icon or button morph. Order 1.22, proposed.
